name: File Icons
about: File Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 930 icons designed by John Gardner. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under ISC.

faqs.q: Are File Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 930 File Icons are open source under the ISC license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the ISC terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use File Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many File Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 930 icons in the File Icons set, designed by John Gardner. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of File Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are File Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
